set_aside.subject: add_captured_trial_case
set_aside.text: add_captured_trial_case: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST first read the Implementation of executed_implementation_id from its own records with when_missing unknown_reference, its UnknownReferenceError propagating; then raises RefusedError naming the first failing check: that implementation's contract_version_id differs from named_contract_version_id, the refusal naming contract_version_id and both identities; then the complete inputs tuple contains a FileFactsRef, including one with no files, the refusal naming FileFactsRef and the first such port in Unicode code-point name order; only after that whole-tuple check passes may any input StoredValue or SpooledFile be looked up or any input bytes be read; then each input port in port name order does not fit by fit_port_value, values read from their StoredValues and checked against the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant, each spooled file of a SpooledFilesRef taken by its SpooledFile facts, its media type equal to the port's and its size_bytes within the imported RELEASE_CEILING_TRIAL_FIXTURE_BYTES_MAX constant; every check comes before any byte is copied, so a refusal copies and writes nothing.

set_aside.subject: add_trial_case
set_aside.text: add_trial_case: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise UnknownReferenceError for an unknown contract version; then RefusedError naming the first name in inputs that is not an input port of the contract version or repeats an earlier name in inputs, then the first name in expected_outputs that is not an output port or repeats an earlier name in expected_outputs, each taken by name in the order given; then checks each input port and, when expected_outputs is given, each output port, in port name order, by fit_port_value with the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant for value ports and the imported RELEASE_CEILING_TRIAL_FIXTURE_BYTES_MAX constant for file ports, a file candidate taking the payload's digest, size and the port's media type; the first failing check, presence, carriage, schema then size, raises RefusedError naming port and check, and nothing is written. A request therefore names exactly the contract's input ports, and its expected_outputs is either absent or names exactly every output port: a partial expected_outputs, and an empty object, is given and fails presence at its first missing port; only absence means no expected outputs.
